text:
alex: Trying the quickstart and getting a 403 on the very first API call after accepting an org invite. API key copied from the console exactly. Anyone run into this? :thinking:

alex: curl example I ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","input":"hi"}'
```

devex-bot: Hey alex — quick checks: is the workspace billing set up? We sometimes gate first requests until billing is activated. See https://console.redwood.ai/workspace/billing :mag_right:

billing-bot: Workspace "acme-team" status: BILLING_PENDING. First-party API requests are restricted until a billing method is attached. Please add a card or start a trial from the billing page. (If you believe this is an error, @jamie can help.)

alex: Huh. I'm on the free trial and I clicked the invite accept link as owner. The console shows "Trial pending" but the API key page says the key is active. No billing prompt showed up during invite flow.

jamie: We recently saw a UX gap where the invite accept flow doesn't always surface the billing modal for some orgs — especially if the org was created via invite link from a partner. There's also a background job that flips the workspace->activated flag; if you call the API immediately you can hit a 403. Workaround: wait ~30-60s or re-open the billing page and hit "Start trial".

samir: Clarifying SDK behavior: our SDKs will NOT retry on 403 by default (we treat it as a client error). They do auto-retry on 429/5xx. However, the quickstart example in the README uses a tiny wrapper that logs "retrying request" for idempotent failures, which can confuse folks when they see retries in logs.

samir: Technical root cause — race between invite acceptance and background activation job. The API permission check uses the workspace.active flag which can lag by a few seconds. We'll push a fix to make the invite flow block until activation completes, and also add a clearer error code on the API (403 -> workspace_not_activated with human hint).

alex: Confirmed workaround worked: waited ~45s, re-generated the key and the same curl returned 200. The Node SDK also logged a single "retrying request" line which made me think the call had been sent twice. :+1:

jamie: I'll open a DX ticket to (1) force a billing modal on accept invite when required, (2) update quickstart README to mention the tiny activation delay, and (3) remove/log less-noisily the retry message for non-retryable errors. Filing DEVEX-1234.

devex-bot: Ticket DEVEX-1234 created: "invite flow billing modal + clearer workspace activation error" — assigned to @jamie and @samir. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/DEVEX-1234 :sparkles:

alex: Thanks all — leaving this thread in case others hit it during onboarding. Saved me a support ticket :)
